title: Nutty Velvety Peruvian Chicken Aji De Gallina
description: A creamy shredded chicken stew made with mild yellow peppers and walnuts, served over low-glycemic cauliflower rice and topped with fresh onion rings.

ingredients.name: Red Onion
ingredients.notes: Half diced for base, half sliced into rings for garnish

instructions: Poach the chicken breasts in simmering water until the internal temperature reaches 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Shred the cooked chicken into bite-sized pieces using two forks.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet and saute the diced onions and minced garlic until translucent.
Stir in the aji amarillo paste and cook for three minutes to release the oils.
Blend the ground walnuts and evaporated milk together until a smooth paste forms.
Pour the walnut mixture and chicken broth into the skillet and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the shredded chicken and parmesan cheese to the sauce and stir until the mixture thickens.
Flash-fry the remaining onion rings in a separate pan until they are slightly softened but still crisp.
Serve the velvety chicken over a bed of steamed cauliflower rice.
Garnish the dish with the fresh stir-fried onion rings and a crack of black pepper.
